title: Broken Supply Cart
description: A supply cart lies overturned, its wheel shattered against a jutting rock. Crates of lumber supplies and tool parts have spilled across the muddy path. Drag marks lead into the underbrush — something hauled the driver away.

outcomes.text: You pry open two intact crates. Good lumber and a handful of coins — the driver won't need them anymore.
Most of the crates are smashed, but one holds quality timber wrapped in oilcloth. Premium stock.
A crate lid splinters under your weight and crashes onto your foot. You limp away with what you can carry.

choices.label: Follow the drag marks
choices.description: The driver might have valuables... or need help.

outcomes.text: You find the driver's coin purse where he dropped it during the struggle. No sign of the man himself.
The trail leads to a beast's feeding ground. You grab scattered valuables and retreat before the creature returns.
Something large and angry is still here! It charges from the undergrowth!
You hear a branch snap in the underbrush and decide discretion is the better part of valor.
